problem: The frozen S3 endpoint retained a 15.5% median GIADA advantage and won all 14 protocols, but only three of five paired seeds; GIADA had won all five seeds at every checkpoint through 72,000 steps.

hypotheses.test: A fresh AdamW control at learning rate 1e-3 improves late robustness from the exact 72k weights.
hypotheses.limit: Historical AdamW state was not saved, so this tests reset versus the historical trajectory contextually, not as an exact causal continuation.

hypotheses.test: Fresh AdamW at 3e-4 or 1e-4 is more robust than the fresh 1e-3 reset control under the same minibatch stream.
EMA readout improves paired seed robustness relative to raw weights without changing training compute or architecture.

evaluation.candidate_selection: Lexicographically maximize: all discovery gates passed; seed wins; median-stratum wins; overall Branch-ELM-minus-GIADA margin. Preserve listed learning-rate/readout order on exact ties.
discovery_gates: GIADA wins all three discovery seeds on overall soma RMSE
GIADA has lower median overall soma RMSE
GIADA has lower median active-transition RMSE
GIADA has lower median somatic-upcrossing RMSE
evaluation.post_selection: Train only the selected learning-rate arm on the two held-out optimizer seeds, then evaluate the selected raw-or-EMA readout for all five seeds on the complete 5.76M-transition development-validation split.

may_diagnose: whether lower late learning rate improves seed robustness under optimizer reset
whether AdamW reset alone is a plausible contributor
may_not_claim: exact continuation of the original optimizer trajectory
interpretation_contract.next_decision: A favorable diagnostic can freeze a prospective training schedule for a new confirmation run; it cannot retroactively replace the failed S3 preregistered endpoint.
